verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਡੁਬਿ ਤਰੈ ਨ ਮਨਤਾਰੂ ਸੁ ਅਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: amia sarovar marai ddub tarai na manataaroo su avaiee|

en.bdb: A headstrong non swimmer would drown and die even in the tank of nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਪੱਥਰਹੁਂ ਕੰਚਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: paaras paras na pa'tharahu(n) ka(n)chan hoi na aghaR ghaRaiee|

en.bdb: Touching the philosopher's stone another stone does not transform into gold nor can it be chiselled into an ornament.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਨ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਅਠ ਪਹਰਿ ਚੰਨਣਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: biseear vis na paraharai aTh pahar cha(n)nan lapaTaiee|

en.bdb: Snake does not shed its poison though it may remain entwined with sandalwood all the eight watches (day and night).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁਂ ਸਖਣਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹਾਂ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhahu(n) sakhanaa rovai dhaahaa(n) maar sunaiee|

en.bdb: In spite of living,in the sea, the conch remains empty and hollow and cries bitterly (when blown).

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ghughoo sujh na sujhiee sooraj jot na lukai lukaiee|

en.bdb: Owl beholds nothing while nothing is hidden in sunshine.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਡਾ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਆਇ ਲੁਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh vaddaa akirataghan dhoojai bhai suaai lubhaiee|

en.bdb: Manmukh, the mind-oriented, is very ungrateful and always likes to enjoy the sense of otherness.
He never cherishes that creator Lord in his heart.
